mike (runtime): heads up — planning a short rollforward probe for FlashAttention v2 -> v3 kernels on staging. scope: kernel selection glue, batching heuristics, KV cache (paged) behavior, and quick correctness checks. can we coordinate small benchmarks + telemetry?

ana (perf): sending a short checklist: 1) run batch-size sweep (B=1,8,16,32) across seq_len {128,512,1024,2048} 2) toggle feature flags: `ff:runtime.flashattn_v3` and `ff:runtime.flashattn_v3_force` 3) run KV-paged hotpath replay (prefix caching + continuation) 4) collect perf counters + nvprof summary + kernel traces 5) run parity eval on small evalset (determinism + logits check)

sam (ml): quick profiler snapshot from my 2048/16 run on aA100 staging:
```
config: v2 vs v3, B=16, seq=2048
v2: 11.8 ms/token (median)
v3: 14.9 ms/token (+26%)
notes: v3 shows higher launch overhead and worse tail latency on paged KV replay
kernel breakdown: flash_attn_v3_kernel (70%), kv_copy(15%), other(15%)
```
I can repro this locally. looks like tiling change in v3 hurts our small-reuse batched flows.

julia (ops): fyi - memory footprint for v3 is lower on long seqs (good), but we saw an increase in peak SM occupancy variance which may explain the tail reg. my suggestion: dynamic kernel chooser heuristics: prefer v3 for seq >= 1024 OR when fused_attention_enabled AND B >= 8; prefer v2 for seq < 1024 or when low-batch/latency-sensitive route.

ana (perf): agree with julia. propose chooser ruleset prototype: `kernel_chooser=v2v3_auto` that evaluates runtime features: seq_len, batch_size, kv_paged_flag, route_latency_slo. heuristics (draft):
```
if kv_paged and seq_len >= 1024: pick v3
elif batch_size >= 8 and seq_len >= 512: pick v3
else: pick v2
```
Also add a safe fallback: `runtime.flashattn_force_v2_on_error` so we can fall back on kernel crashes/regressions.

mike (runtime): rollout plan idea: 1) CI microbench lane for v3 with our replay harness (fast) 2) staged canary: a) 2% traffic pinned to canary pool for 24h b) 10% in dedicated for 48h c) ramp to 50% with continuous telemetry check 3) require perf delta threshold: no >10% reg on median tokens and <15% on p95; if exceeded -> auto rollback to v2 and alert oncall.

sam (ml): one more datapoint — fused-attn workloads (where we fused qkv project) show v3 wins for seq>=4096 by ~20% on throughput. so chooser must include fused flag. also watch FP16 numerical diffs: small but present on some prompt shapes. add automated checksum gating.

julia (ops): add these observability hooks before ramp: per-route token latency, kernel selection histogram, kv-page hit ratio, and a lightweight checksum comparison between v2/v3 outputs for the first 100 tokens of each request. we should stream a sample of diffs to the perf channel.

mike (runtime): can someone run a small matrix and drop results here by EOD? I can wire the feature flags and canary config if we have the heuristics fleshed out. also need a short playbook for rollback steps.

ana (perf): I'll run B={1,8,16} x seq={128,512,1024,2048} on staging GPU pool (2 x A100). posting a summary in ~4h. I'll include nvprof and trace timestamps.

sam (ml): I'll run fused-attn path and KV-paged replay with realistic prefixes. expect results in ~3h.

julia (ops): I'll prepare canary policy in console: pinned routing, metric alerts (median token latency, p95, kernel-errors), and an automatic ff kill switch. also adding an audit event for any force-fallback.

deploy-bot: smoke canary job queued: job_id=canary-probe-2198765432, pools=staging-a100-1, config=ff:runtime.flashattn_v3=false/true toggles.

mike (runtime): perfect. include a short checklist for QE: deterministic seed, identical tokenizer, and replay harness so diffs are meaningful. once we have the matrix we'll decide final selector thresholds. thanks all.

ana (perf): ack :thumbsup:
